name: Guilloche
author: E. T. Carter
description: A banknote border band of fine taut strands woven over-under into a continuous machined braid of lozenges on near-black steel; the pattern never moves — only its phase travels longitudinally so the braid perpetually re-weaves, and the only light is specular sparks where strands cross.

params.label: Weave speed
params.effect: Multiplies the longitudinal phase travel of the strands; 0 freezes a static engraved braid, 2 visibly re-weaves the lozenges every few seconds.

params.label: Stroke width
params.effect: Width of each strand stroke in CSS pixels — hairline banknote engraving at the minimum, thick ribbon strands that swell into solid woven bands at the maximum.

params.label: Braid depth
params.effect: Amplitude of each strand's sine about its band axis; low relaxes the field toward parallel pinstripes with rare shallow crossings, high weaves deep overlapping lozenges.

params.label: Glint
params.effect: Brightness of the specular sparks where strands cross; 0 leaves the bare unjeweled weave, 2 sets a bright jewel at every lozenge corner.

params.label: Randomize
params.effect: Scatters where each strand's wave starts and ends; 0 is the orderly aligned braid, higher offsets every strand by a random phase so the weave looks hand-drawn and irregular.

params.label: Tube roll
params.effect: Rounds the flat strands into 3D tubes and runs a helical highlight around them so they appear to rotate; 0 is the flat engraved line, higher gives glossy spinning rods (best read with thicker strokes).

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Rotates the whole woven braid to any angle, so the bands can run level, on a diagonal, or vertically while the frame stays put.

params.label: Color blend
params.effect: Blurs the strand colours together where they overlap; 0 keeps crisp single-colour tubes with hard seams, higher averages the overlapping strands so the colours bleed into smooth gradients.

params.label: Seam angle
params.effect: Shears the over-under colour seams off vertical onto a diagonal; 0 leaves the upright crossings, higher tilts them so the colour breaks run at an angle across the weave.
